segments.he: אָמַר רַב אַחָא בַּר חֲנִינָא אָמַר אַבָּיֵי אָמַר רַבִּי אַסִּי אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: מִשּׁוּם פְּגַם מִשְׁפָּחָה.
segments.en: Why is he under obligation to serve in the Temple? «Rav Aḥa bar Ḥanina said» that «Abaye said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» He is obligated «due to» the potential «family flaw,» i.e., harm to the family name. If he does not serve with these watches, people will infer that both families are unfit for the priesthood, which is not the case.
